name: apple-passwords
description: Use Apple Passwords autofill in Google Chrome and authorize one-time native Mac login password fills without exposing credentials to the assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Use saved credentials safely in Chrome and native Mac prompts.
interface.longDescription: Use the official iCloud Passwords extension in Google Chrome, plus a human-approved credential broker that fills the Mac login password into signed native secure dialogs one time, while keeping every saved secret outside the assistant context.
defaultPrompt: Sign in with my saved Apple Passwords credential.
Use Apple Passwords autofill for this login.
Safely fill my Mac password into this native prompt.
